<!-- pr-reviewer: 323bac95f3aed26756c3b4d7d5b797afd856c936 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

## What looks good

- The spans do not change behaviour. Each `time(...)` and `span(...)` call wraps the same call that was there before. The span reads one thread-local flag and does nothing more unless `frame_cost::record` runs. No span result controls what the frame draws.
- `frame_cost::record` sets the flag off again in a drop guard. Thus a panic in the probe does not leave the flag on.
- The PR has no change to posted G-code, gouge or collision checks, stock simulation, geometry or goldens. This is not a safety-tier review.
- The probe test asserts counts only, not times. Thus it cannot become flaky because of machine speed.
- `crates/ui/AGENTS.md` is a process file. The body has `Process change: yes`, and the PR does not edit `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION`. Correct.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2238-frame-cost-rule.md` has the correct format: what was decided, why, what was dropped, and the cost to change later.
- No `scripts/`, `.github/`, `build.rs`, `Cargo.toml` or dependency change.
- No visible UI change. Thus before/after screenshots are not necessary.

## Results (locally, trial merge with `upstream/main` e808c9629)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (debug, from `crates/ui`) | 967 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored |
| `frame_cost::tests::spans_count_only_while_recording` | pass |
| `egui_app::tests::frame_cost_probe::still_frames_on_fig8_name_their_costs` | pass (also with `--nocapture`; regions, walks, digests and slices are 0 in all five states) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The trial merge had no conflicts.

## Mutations (run locally, then reverted)

1. In `frame_cost.rs`, the `Off` guard sets the flag to `true` (the flag stays on after `record`). The probe test is red: state (b) records no `scene/collect` (`left: 0, right: 6`). The unit test `spans_count_only_while_recording` stays green (see note 1).
2. In `boundary.rs`, remove the `ui/properties.boundary.preview` span. The probe test is red at the (c) assertion (`left: 0, right: 6`).

## Requested before merge

None.

## Notes (not blocking)

1. `crates/ui/src/frame_cost.rs` (test `spans_count_only_while_recording`): mutation 1 above does not make this test red. When the flag stays on, the second `record` returns early with an empty list, and the test asserts an empty list. Add `assert!(!ON.with(Cell::get))` after the first `record`, or record a span after it and assert that it is not counted.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/frame_cost_probe.rs:241-244`: the comment says "slices no part", but the test asserts `walks` and `digests` only. `regions` and `slices` are measured and printed, but not asserted. In this run, both were 0 in all five states. An assertion on `slices` (and `regions`, if that is the intent) would hold the claim.
3. `frame_cost_probe.rs:246`: `scene/collect` is a span that the test itself opens, so this count is always N. The `scene/parts.models` assertion (line 247) is the one that checks the product code.
4. `frame_cost_probe.rs:249-250`: the comment says "The Boundary group draws only in (c)". With `--nocapture`, `ui/properties.boundary.preview` and `scene/parts.boundary_preview.triangulate` also run one time for each frame in (d) and (e) (the Face page shows the Boundary group). The cost is small (about 0.02 ms). Correct the comment, or assert the count in (d) and (e) as well.
5. File size: `op_page.rs` was 423 lines and is now 425. `shell.rs` (1050), `state.rs` and `interact.rs` also grow by some lines. These files were already over 400 lines.
6. The body ends with `Refs #2238`, not `Fixes #N`. This is correct, because this PR does steps 1 and 2 only, and the sub-issues #2246 to #2250 stay open.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
